doc.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Charlie Shavers's picture record
summary: He describes his favorite childhood 78 by Charlie Shavers and later knowing Shavers.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: It was a picture on both sides of the record.
Yes, I’ll show it to you. I would go would get this record and play it. On one side, it was called “She’s Funny That Way” and on the other side was “Dizzy’s Dilemma.”
And they you grew up to know Charlie Shavers until the end of his life.
